reason: ACCT-RULEREG-K-1. Original-authorship effective-date / rule-version registry resolver, authored from scratch for this estate per ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §2. No third-party source, package, or code was copied into it: the closed filer-status enum, the half-open parameter-window resolution, the ISO calendar arithmetic and the bounded in-guest slice-digest assertion are all written for this row. Its pure-JS UTF-8 encoder and SHA-256 are the estate's own validated in-house construction (ART595-ART590-UTF8-FIX-1, already shipped in art-199/200/206/210/280/584/620 and _dtree.bundle.mjs), reused rather than re-authored, and likewise not third-party. Named `_ruleversion.bundle.mjs` (not `_ruleversion.mjs`) because ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates the shipped `_detmath.bundle.mjs` shape verbatim for any shared, inline-consumed kernel bundle — the RISC0 guest provides only `_hash`, so a bundle import is unavailable in-guest and this filename convention is how the estate marks 'reuse vehicle, always inlined, never imported at runtime', independent of authorship.
